title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Earnings Due After Market Close Wednesday: Revenue Seen at $92.2B, Up ~97% YoY
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reports Q2 FY2027 earnings after market close today (Aug 26). Analysts forecast revenue of $92.2 billion (+97.4% YoY) and EPS of $2.09—nearly double a year ago—as AI data center demand continues to surge. Nvidia guided to ~$91B ±2%. Futures slipped 0.5% pre-earnings, reflecting elevated expectations.
why: 英伟达财报是本季度最重要的全市场事件：结果直接影响AI芯片供需预期、半导体板块走势及纳斯达克情绪；持有相关供应链标的（SK海力士）或科技股卖put者需关注隐含波动率变化。

title: Oil drops more than 3% as U.S. shifts to economic pressure on Iran, easing fears of renewed war
summary: Brent crude fell 3.9% to $88.58/bbl and WTI lost 3.1% to $82.36 on Tuesday as the U.S. pivoted from threatened military escalation to an economic-pressure campaign against Iran ('Operation Economic Outcast'). Sanctions were less aggressive than feared, with China not fully exempted, sending geopolitical risk premiums lower.
why: 油价单日暴跌直接压低通胀预期、推升美股，同时降低美联储年底加息概率，对持有消费与科技股的组合整体正面；能源板块若持有相关期权需注意波动率压缩。

title: S&P 500 +0.32%, Nasdaq +0.66% on Aug 25 as yields fall; Asian stocks set to extend gains
summary: S&P 500 closed at 7,677.28 (+0.32%), Nasdaq +0.66%, Dow +0.3% on Tuesday. 10-year Treasury yield fell 7bps to 4.625% as oil prices slumped on Iran de-escalation. Semiconductor stocks led gains ahead of Nvidia's earnings Wednesday. Bloomberg's Markets Wrap notes Asian futures pointing higher Wednesday morning.
why: 美股整体上涨、债券收益率回落，为港股开盘提供正面外围；芯片股领涨有利英伟达财报行情炒作，关注今晚结果对亚太半导体板块的传导。

title: Oil falls again Wednesday as U.S. pivots to economic pressure on Iran
summary: Crude oil extends Tuesday's 3%+ loss into Wednesday (Aug 26) as markets continue to price out Iran military-conflict risk following Washington's 'Operation Economic Outcast' sanctions strategy. Brent and WTI remain under pressure as the focus shifts from supply disruption risk to demand-side signals.
why: 油价连续两日下跌有助于压制通胀担忧，支撑美联储维持现有利率路径（3.50–3.75%）；对消费与科技板块整体偏多；关注今日英伟达财报前后油价与美股的联动。

title: Alibaba Raises $10 Billion in Record Hong Kong Share Sale for AI Expansion
summary: Alibaba priced 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 (8.4% discount) on Aug 23, raising HK$80 billion ($10.2B USD)—the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company and third-largest globally this year. The deal was ~3× oversubscribed; co-founder Jack Ma participated. Proceeds go 100% to AI infrastructure. Settlement completes today (Aug 26). Shares fell 8.1% on Aug 24.
why: 港股史上最大配股对市场估值体系有重要参考意义：阿里以折价8.4%完成大型融资且获超额认购，显示国际资金对中国AI主题的信心；同时股价短期稀释压力已于8月24日基本消化，今日结算后关注是否出现「利空出尽」反弹。延续报道：配股已于8月26日完成交割。

title: PDD Holdings Q2 2026 earnings: profit falls 12%, beats estimates; revenue misses as Temu loses users
summary: PDD Q2 revenue rose 8% to 112.36B yuan ($16.6B), missing the 116.35B yuan consensus. Net income fell 12% YoY to 27.18B yuan (beat 24.40B estimate). Temu's monthly active users contracted 11% YoY to 467M—its first major measured decline—as EU import duties pressured cross-border business. R&D spending surged 40%; management is accelerating local merchant onboarding.
why: 拼多多营收低于预期叠加Temu月活首降，反映跨境电商监管压力加剧；期权投资者应关注PDD隐含波动率回落至何水平；同时EU关税对Temu的冲击可能波及其他跨境电商。

title: Tesla Cybercab to launch Sept. 3 as robotaxi bet ramps up
summary: Tesla will hold an exclusive Cybercab launch event in Austin, Texas on September 3. The steering-wheel-free vehicle designed purely for autonomy will begin with employee rides before joining commercial Robotaxi service. Tesla's fleet has now accumulated over 380,000 unsupervised miles across seven US markets. Prediction markets give only a 17% chance Tesla sells a $30K Cybercab this year.
why: Cybercab正式发布是特斯拉Robotaxi商业化最重要的里程碑事件，预计引发TSLA股价波动；对持有TSLA的投资者，9月3日前可考虑covered call策略锁定部分涨幅；同时留意发布会上的定价与量产时间线披露。延续报道：事件持续发酵，9月3日发布会即将举行。

title: A Preview in One Chart: Meituan's Q2 Earnings Report Due Aug 28; Stock Fell 5.6% on Aug 25
summary: Meituan (3690.HK) Q2 2026 earnings are scheduled for August 28 after market close (HK time 7pm). Institutions expect revenue of ~93.8 billion yuan (+14% YoY), but profitability faces pressure from food delivery subsidy wars. The stock fell from HK$82.70 to HK$78.05 (-5.6%) on August 25, possibly reflecting pre-earnings caution.
why: 美团临近财报，股价提前大幅回调或已部分反映盈利压力；外卖补贴战短期压制利润但巩固市场份额长期价值不变；若财报后股价进一步下跌至支撑位，可考虑sell put策略；关注即时配送、到店业务增长数据。
